title: Compression Attacks
description: Side channels created when compression behavior depends on hidden data.

attacks.name: BREACH
attacks.desc: BREACH infers a secret from compressed HTTP response lengths when attacker input is reflected near it.
attacks.prevention: Avoid compressing responses that mix secrets with attacker-controlled text; separate secrets and use per-request masking where needed.

attacks.name: HEIST
attacks.desc: HEIST combines browser-visible timing with compression effects to infer cross-origin response size changes.

attacks.name: Compression oracle
attacks.desc: A compression oracle leaks information when an attacker can vary input and observe output length beside a secret.
